policy.cohort: 21 complete immutable originals / 10 channels / 1149 validated dense 20s windows; same five incomplete originals excluded from both heads
policy.target: Human final selected interval is preferred to label-independent alternative spans; omitted material is not assigned a bad/negative frame label
policy.features: Overlap-weighted pooled audio train-fold PCA16 + frozen SigLIP train-fold PCA8 + log(seconds), duration_fraction, start_fraction, end_fraction; geometry control zeros the first24
policy.pca: Training-original windows only; every original total1, weighted centering/randomized SVD, seed29, n_iter3; no gold-conditioned frame selection
policy.scaling: All28 symmetric gold-minus-alternative features, weighted StandardScaler fit only on training pairs; no centering at inference because pairwise differences cancel means
policy.candidates: All legal spans from original endpoints plus every validated dense window start/end, duration >= min(5,original seconds), no duration cap; no held-out gold endpoints injected
policy.alternatives: Exactly64 uniformly indexed label-independent grid alternatives per original (or all if fewer); remove exact self-comparison after sampling, do not replace it
policy.training: C1 liblinear symmetric logistic, no intercept, max_iter2000, seed29; gold-minus-alternative positive and its negation negative; each original total80 signed sample weight, no class_weight
policy.decision: Argmax legal span; score ties within1e-10 prefer original then longer then earlier start/end
policy.policy_selection: Outer5/inner3 whole channels; each fixed family chooses argmax only if inner macro IoU improves identity and retention >=.97 / p10 >=.9, otherwise identity
policy.gate: Primary IoU > identity+.02, macro retention >=.97, p10 >=.9, >=3 cuts shortened >=5s; 5000 paired-channel bootstrap lower gain >0 and lower retention >=.97; paired control gain lower >0; exact zero-mass guard
policy.pooling_limitation: 20s overlapping-window vectors pooled by overlap, not a fresh exact-span encoding; no extrapolation and no claim omitted content is worthless
policy.production: Envelope remains disabled pending independent review and runtime parity; no media/GPU/cloud/new labels/DB writes
